_aliases_note: Names the script LLM keeps inventing for the third child, mapped to the cast member that shot actually meant. Observed in 20260719-bennys-brushing (Amira alongside Kofi+Zuri -> Nala) and 20260719-rainbow-friends (Luna alongside Kofi+Nala -> Zuri). Aliases are used ONLY when a name fails to resolve; they never shadow a real cast name.
_build_note: Each character's `build` is spliced into the prompt by cast._describe_dict as "<Name>, a <age> with <build>, <skin>, <hair>", so it MUST be a NOUN phrase ("a tall, sturdy build ..."), never an adjective phrase. An adjective phrase produces ungrammatical prompt text ("a girl with petite and delicate, deep brown skin") in the one sentence the cast-integrity gates depend on. Enforced by tests/test_kidsong_cast.py::test_every_bible_build_is_a_noun_phrase.
